 (Shri Rohit Shrivastava - Panel Lawyer & Shri Rohit Jagwani -
 Advocate For The Respondent [Comp].)

This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No. 760 of 2023 registered at Police Station Karera, District Shivpuri (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 354, 323, 342, 506, 34 of IPC further added Section 376(D), 328 of IPC.

First application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 03.04.2024 passed in M.CrC.
No.12779/2024.
2.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent a n d h a s been falsely implicated.
It is further argued that present FIR is counterblast of FIR bearing crime no.761/2023.

Further argument is that both the parties have filed FIR on account of some personal dispute,
however, the matter has now been settled between the parties for which the petition bearing M.Cr.C.
No.17978/2024 & M.Cr.C. No.17979/2024 have been filed for quashing the FIR on the basis of Ramniwas Lodhi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11751558/
1 compromise entered into between the parties.

sentences.text: The case is not supported by medical evidence.
The applicant is in custody since 16.01.2024.
After conclusion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed, therefore, further custodial interrogation is no more required.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Shivpuri (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconding or tempering with prosecution case.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
3. Per contra, learned counsel for the State has vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

4. Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.
5.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.100,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with one local solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
8. E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
9. Certified copy as per rules.
